title: Repeatedly sets off my smoke alarm.  I'm a little scared to toast anything.
text: Repeatedly sets off my smoke alarm.  I'm a little scared to toast anything.. The first time I used it I put it on 1 and let it "burn off" whatever it was supposed to burn off.  Within seconds the smoke alarm went off.  I opened the door and turned on the air conditioning so it stopped pretty quick but I'm really afraid to toast anything in it - it was just barely a wisp of smoke coming out of the toaster.  I tried the "1" setting one more time and again, the smoke alarm went off.  So the real problem is that I have a smoke alarm that is a little overly sensitive, but I live in a Senior Independent Living apartment and each apartment has about 30 sprinklers in addition to the smoke alarm.  Nobody has been able to tell me under what conditions cause the sprinklers to turn on - but you can bet I'll be cleaning that crumb tray everytime I've used it.  I've never seen an appliance get so hot on a low setting.  I guess it's gook to know this before I cooked a couple of Rib-eye steaks in a frying pan full of butter and other seasonings  - it will never happen.  So in a way this toaster has been a blessing.  Sure going to miss those ribeyes. Update - still unable to use it without setting off fire alarm.  It also is made of thin cheap metal - it really feels cheap.  To late to return so it's going in the trash.

product_metadata.title: Mueller UltraToast Full Stainless Steel Toaster 4 Slice, Long Extra-Wide Slots with Removable Tray, Cancel/Defrost/Reheat Functions, 6 Browning Levels with LED Display

Full Control – Six browning settings let you take control of your toasting level so you can enjoy your toast exactly how you like it. Memory recall keeps your settings saved, but with sleek touch buttons and LED display, it’s just as easy to switch between settings.

Extra-Wide Slots – With each slot at 1.6 inch wide, the 4 slice toaster lets you fit long, thick slices of artisan bread, Texas toast, bagels, English muffins, and plenty more of your favorites. Perfect size for the modern family, with hungry mouths to feed each morning!

Easy To Clean – Toasters are bound to collect crumbs, but with the removable crumb tray, cleaning is effortless. Make use of the handy under-base cord storage to keep the bread toaster compact and tidy. Designed with quality components, this brushed stainless steel toaster is a guaranteed welcome addition to your kitchen.
